Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
Is the Sensory Deprivation a D action to the target minion/retainer?
There isn't the typical D on the card nor in the errata, but i think it
sholud be.
Thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.

The (D) is just a reminder - it's presence or absence has no effect on
whether a particular action is directed or not - the target of the action
determines that. Sense Dep should have a (D) symbol, yes, but that doesn't
affect its functionality.
